original.question: Brett is 14 years old. In four years his sister Angela will be thrice as old as Brett is now. How old is Angela right now?
original.answer:
Four years from now Angela will be 14*3=<<14*3=42>>42.
Right now Angela is 42-4=<<42-4=38>>38 years old.
